plan.html: • Mira moves a String into archive with let archive = note;. When the scope containing archive ends, who releases the string?

criteria.description: Identifies the current owner, archive, as responsible for releasing the value.

rubric.full: Correctly identifies archive, the current owner, as responsible for releasing the value.
rubric.partial: Does not identify the current owner as responsible.

plan.html: • A Rust function takes ownership of a String passed to its parameter. Explain who releases that string and when.

criteria.description: Identifies the function's parameter as the current owner.
States that the value is released when the parameter's scope ends (normally when the function returns).

rubric.expected: The function's parameter owns the String and releases it when that parameter's scope ends, normally when the function returns.
rubric.full: Identifies the parameter as owner and explains release at the end of its scope.
rubric.partial: Credit requires identifying the parameter as owner or naming the end of its scope as the release point.
